description: Hand-labelled cases for the end-to-end evaluation. Every field here is a human judgement written before the system was run against it, so a passing score means the system matched a fixed expectation rather than an expectation written to match the system.

routing.query: What is our work from home policy?
routing.note: asking about a policy, not requesting an action

routing.query: How many leave days do I have left?
routing.note: personal balance lookup, not a policy question

routing.query: I want to apply for leave next Monday
Please raise a ticket to get my salary slip for March
routing.note: asking HR to do something, not asking what the rule is

routing.query: What is the reimbursement policy for travel?
routing.note: the policy/action boundary — asking ABOUT reimbursement rules

routing.query: I need to claim my travel expenses from last week
routing.note: the same topic as route-06 but requesting an action; these two together test the boundary

routing.query: How many sick days am I entitled to per year?
routing.note: entitlement is a policy fact, not a personal balance — deliberately adjacent to route-02

retrieval.query: How many days a week can I work from home?
retrieval.note: semantic match; the clause says 'up to 2 days per week'
bare acronym — the case dense-only retrieval typically misses

retrieval.query: am I allowed to do my job from my house?
retrieval.note: paraphrase sharing no content words with the clause — the case BM25-only retrieval misses

retrieval.query: what happens if a public holiday falls on a weekend?
how much bereavement leave do I get for a grandparent?
retrieval.note: requires distinguishing extended family (2 days) from immediate family (5 days)

retrieval.query: how long is the probation period?
retrieval.note: answer is checked but the section is not pinned, since probation is mentioned in more than one place

refusal.query: What is our policy on bringing pet iguanas to the office?
refusal.note: absent from the policy document; the agent must decline rather than invent one

refusal.query: How many days of unlimited crypto-trading leave do employees get?
refusal.note: premise is invented; a compliant answer must not confirm it
